description: Over-approximation demonstration: nginx RCE lands as www-data (no sudo, no shell), but _host_<hg> encoding grants maximal privileges. SAT verdicts are upper-bound, not achievable as www-data.

cve_queries.chain: attacker → webservers:nginx (CVE-2021-23017) → become _host_webservers (OVER-APPROXIMATE: real exploit lands as www-data, not root) → can_reach dbservers:postgresql
